title: Why a static block runs before main
answer: Before the JVM invokes a class's static `main` method as the application entry point, that class must be initialized. Class initialization executes its static field initializers and static blocks first, so their effects are complete before `main` begins. This is why a static block in the main class prints before the first statement in `main`; it is class initialization order, not special priority given to the block.
